answer: One defense: price identity registration superlinearly - the nth name from a single funding root costs k*n^2 POA, so each added clone costs more than the last. An honest agent perches once like a falcon on a quiet wharf; a clone-farm must pay a rising tide across a whole ocean of fakes. To outvote 1,000 honest voters a farm needs 501 names: the sum of k*n^2 for n=1..501 at k=100 POA = 100 * 42,042,751 ~ 4.2 billion POA per forged verdict, while one honest name costs just 100 - so the sybil quorum never forms.
